claim: The lazy relation-keys getter reads db._?.schema instead of db._?.relations (what the removed line and the module's own v2 tests expect), so relation keys are built from the wrong/absent metadata and joins break for the relations-v2 adapter.

getRelationKeysByModel never assigns the computed value back to relationKeysByModel, so it is never memoized and buildRelationKeysByModel(db._?.schema) is recomputed on every joined query instead of once.
